info.name: 📌 Deepgram API
info.description:
### About Deepgram

"Power enterprise voice solutions with Deepgram’s Speech-to-Text, Text-to-Speech, and Voice Agent APIs."

Deepgram builds its own Nova speech-to-text and Aura text-to-speech models. On the workspace overview it is listed under **Speech & audio**.

### Prerequisites

- Postman Account
    
- Deepgram Account: [https://developers.deepgram.com/](https://developers.deepgram.com/)
    

### Usage

1. Create a fork
    
2. Update collection variables
    
3. Send requests

Start with the 🚀 Get Started folder.

Add your key to your **Postman Vault** as `deepgram_api_key` (Vault icon in the footer, then **Add secret**, using that exact name). Requests read it as `{{vault:deepgram_api_key}}`, so your key never leaves your device.

### Documentation

- API: [https://developers.deepgram.com/reference/deepgram-api-overview](https://developers.deepgram.com/reference/deepgram-api-overview)
    
- Models: [https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/model](https://developers.deepgram.com/docs/model)
